text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: *pant*... It's so cool and minty...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Will I be able to run properly today? I 
wonder if I can show the results of my 
training.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If my running isn't cool at all, and I 
make them think it's okay even if they 
lose again...
choice_data_list: It's okay, hard work never betrays you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I did everything I could. I'm sure 
it'll be fine...!
choice_data_list:
Go show them the strength you've 
cultivated.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm gonna go put on a sparkling run!

I encouraged Yukino Bijin like that, but 
in reality, there's no telling how things 
will go depending on today's race results. 
Even so—
choice_data_list:
(All I can do is pray that she can give it 
her all.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fans
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, awesome... Are all those people fans 
of Yukino Bijin?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it? She's holding plushies. Seems 
like she has more than she did at the 
Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Man... just how far is this gonna spread? 
Fads are seriously something else."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...We gotta fire ourselves up too and 
cheer on Harp Alpha!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah~! Yukino-chaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawa!? W-What a crazy crowd...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Was it like this before? Even though I 
lost... There are still so many people 
believing in me—)

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Win today for sure, Yukino-chan! I'm 
rooting for you~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haaah, thank you so—

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Because if you don't win, you don't get 
to be center stage at the live!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna hear a cute song! Let me wave 
penlights in the front row~!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wanting them to win... is that what that 
means...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe there's no one out there who 
actually looks forward to watching me 
run...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Even though... I'm getting this much 
support...!?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...No, Trainer believes in me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, I gotta go run...!"
